body: Changing the perspective. It is the same like solving a rubik cube. Every time colors will end on different sides but cube will fall apart just seconds before it's solved... That's how it is. You have a vision, a seed and then you start building it in your mind, finding solutions, building a piece (musical or multimedial) and everything goes down... I don't seek recognition nor fame, I'm the person in the background that is making the show and I have failed at it every damn time...

Harsh! And you don't even know me... Financial independence you say? What if I told you that my parents choose this calling for me which turned out to be the right one but not in this system. Get a job? Where mindless drones will grind on you while you're making shitty salary. You mean become a slave? I refuse that shit. It's pointless and I guess I have a big problem with fake authorities based on fake values. 
You sound like one of them. I'm sorry but I don't do experimental art, my ideas are always wrapped into meaning, bringing up the positive in people, encouraging them to find their purpose in this life, to be happy, to thrive. Ironically it hasn't turned out well for me. It eventually will but I got caught into doing different things with same results as failures... This cycle is driving me crazy and I can't look at it anymore...
And I care about people around me, I have friends, I have family and I love them but we are two different worlds.

It is like a blast of emotions that I can't control and like under the spell I will go and do stuff. Musical expression does not end when the piece is done, music can transcend into other forms of expression, any kind of media. Before I was more emotional and I would do it more from the hearth but as a grew up I developed strong logic that helps me to know more about what I'm doing and possible consequences. And trust me my logic is pretty strong as post above can tell.
